name: Abel Daniel
tagline: I work with brands to create logos, brand identities and visual systems, with a passion for Ethiopian cultural patterns and the Ethiopic typeface.
about:
My name is Abel Daniel, and I am a graphic designer. For over five years, I've been diving deep into the world of graphic design. I specialize in working with brands to create logos, brand identities, and visual branding.

Whether I'm collaborating with a team or working on my own, I always aim to blend consistency with a burst of creativity. I have developed many professional Ethiopic fonts.
